title: FBI-UAP-D037, FD-302, “Multiple Red Lights,” 2026
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview record detailing three UAP sighting events in 2026, including reports of anomalous time discrepancies on a mechanical watch.

incidents.summary: Two unidentified lights observed moving along a ridgeline.
incidents.quote: described the lights as "dash" shaped and dull red in color to the naked eye.

incidents.summary: A single unidentified light appeared directly above the observers' location.
incidents.quote: another, similar unidentified light appear directly above their location

incidents.summary: Multiple lights observed to the east, including low-altitude objects and a glow in a dry wash.
incidents.quote: The unidentified light appeared to move toward them and stopped approximately 400 meters away.
